objective: Fix explicit desktop screen analysis so thinking-capable Ollama vision models return a bounded final answer, surface analysis success or failure instead of only snapshot acceptance, and restore the OS-encrypted API-key/model configuration clearly enough that the owner can reuse or overwrite the key without rediscovery or model reselection.
non_goals: Do not add a new vision provider, dependency, model or endpoint.
Do not expose, decrypt into the renderer, log or return the persisted API key.
Do not add automatic/background screen capture or persist normal snapshot pixels.
Do not change the text-brain model, OCR model, scheduler budgets or observation TTL.
Do not open another product module or run deep/repeat/soak verification.
contracts: Explicit vision requests set Ollama chat think=false so the bounded token budget is spent on message.content rather than a hidden reasoning trace.
A snapshot response distinguishes base evidence acceptance from OCR or vision analysis success, not-requested and error states.
The Dashboard shows provider/model error codes and correlation ID without returning raw provider payloads or secrets.

When the persisted provider, model and encrypted key exist, the Dashboard restores them without model discovery and defaults explicit capture to vision analysis until the owner changes that preference.
Submitting an empty key input reuses the stored key; submitting a non-empty key atomically validates and replaces the encrypted key only after runtime configuration succeeds.
The renderer may know only apiKeyConfigured=true/false and can never read the stored key.
allowed_dependencies: Existing Python standard library and pinned perception worker dependencies
Vue 3 and Electron APIs already pinned in the workspace
oss_candidates: No new dependency; use the existing Ollama /api/chat contract and its documented think=false field.
acceptance_criteria: The owner correlation case no longer renders only Hina đã nhận ảnh when vision analysis failed; the exact bounded provider error code is visible.
A thinking-capable Ollama response request contains think=false and returns only non-empty final content to the perception observation.
A saved Cloud key is labeled as stored with Windows encryption, and the persisted model remains selectable immediately after restart without discovery.
The owner can paste a replacement key and click one save/overwrite action while retaining the persisted model.
When a configured provider is restored, explicit screen capture has vision analysis selected by default; an intentional owner toggle remains respected.
Fast perception tests, desktop build/typecheck/unit tests, workspace check and one bounded real-provider smoke pass.
